topic: What if Garp took Luffy into the Marines: Sabo, Smoker, Marineford and Koby's switch
title: What If Luffy Joined The Marines?
description:
What if Garp had taken Luffy to Marine headquarters instead of leaving him with Dadan? Follow one change through East Blue, Loguetown and Marineford, with a twist at Koby.

Would Luffy be a better pirate for having been a Marine, or does the uniform ruin the dream? Tell me in the comments.

0:00 The Question
0:15 Mount Colubo
2:32 Alvida And The Ensign
3:48 Smoker's Town
5:11 The Deserter
7:20 Marineford
10:15 The Loss
12:02 The Verdict
tags: what if luffy joined the marines
comment: Is Luffy a better pirate for having been a Marine, or does the uniform ruin the dream? Pick one.

lines.text: What if Luffy joined the Marines?

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine garp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Would he become the hero Garp always wanted? Or does the Marines break the one man who was born to break them?

shot.fallback: anime style luffy garp marines, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: To understand how we get there, we have to go back to Mount Colubo.

shot.fallback: anime style mount colubo dadan luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Garp is a Vice Admiral with one dream for his grandsons. He wants Luffy and Ace to become Marines.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy ace marine dream, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Garp trains them the hard way, then leaves them with Dadan and the Mountain Bandits, and hopes it takes.

shot.fallback: anime style garp dadan mountain bandits, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: It doesn't take. Ace says he'll be a pirate. Luffy follows Shanks, and Garp's dream is dead before it starts.

shot.fallback: anime style garp furious luffy pirate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In our story, one thing changes. Garp doesn't leave Luffy on the mountain. He takes him to Marine headquarters.

shot.fallback: anime style garp marine headquarters luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy is still a rubber kid with a mouth that never stops. But now he wakes up to a Marine bugle every morning.

shot.fallback: anime style young luffy marine base, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Garp's training is not gentle. In canon, he is the one who taught the future Admiral Kuzan how to use Haki.

shot.fallback: anime style garp kuzan haki training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now Luffy is a recruit in that same program, and he treats every drill like a game he can't lose.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine recruits training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's my first rule for this timeline. Garp can make Luffy tougher. He cannot make him obey.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy fist of love, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Luffy already has a dream. Chapter 1, he told Shanks he would be the Pirate King, and he meant it.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy pirate king dream shanks, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So he plays along. He eats the Marine food and he learns the Marine ropes, and he keeps his Straw Hat in a locker.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy straw hat shanks hat, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Meanwhile, Ace is alone on the mountain, with only Sabo for company. That's the first ripple.

shot.fallback: anime style ace sabo gray terminal, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Sabo, Ace and Luffy swore to be pirates together. Without Luffy there, the cup of brothers is never going to be the same.

shot.fallback: anime style ace sabo luffy brothers cup, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, chapter 585, Sabo's ship is destroyed by a Celestial Dragon. Ace and Luffy watch from the shore.

shot.fallback: anime style sabo ship celestial dragon cannon, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In our story, Luffy isn't on that shore. Ace watches it alone, and Garp doesn't tell Luffy for months.

shot.fallback: anime style ace sabo ship explodes, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Think about that. A kid hears his brother was killed, and the man who tells him wears the Marine coat.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy sabo death news, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: This is the first crack. Luffy doesn't hate the Marines, he just can't forgive what they let happen.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy sad marine coat, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And that crack is exactly where Oda's story would find a way in.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine justice doubt, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter two begins in East Blue.

shot.fallback: anime style east blue luffy marine ship, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: By his late teens, Luffy is a Marine ensign on a patrol ship, and his captain is already sick of him.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine ensign ship, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Remember Alvida, the pirate captain who ate the Smooth-Smooth Fruit? In canon, Luffy beats her in chapter 2, because her club can't hurt rubber.

shot.fallback: anime style alvida luffy club chapter 2, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here, Luffy is the one in uniform. He lands on her ship to arrest her, and Alvida's whole crew laughs.

shot.fallback: anime style alvida pirates ship luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But the laughing stops when her club hits Luffy and bounces, and then Luffy's punch flattens her.

shot.search: Luffy Gomu Gomu no Pistol Alvida
shot.fallback: anime style luffy gomu gomu no pistol alvida, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And standing in the hold is a chubby cabin boy named Koby. He's been Alvida's slave for two years.

shot.fallback: anime style koby alvida cabin boy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Koby asks Luffy how to join the Marines. Here, Koby is looking at a Marine.

shot.fallback: anime style koby luffy marines dream, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So he asks the question differently. Does a pirate-hearted Marine even belong in this uniform?

shot.fallback: anime style koby luffy marine uniform, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Luffy gets quiet. He says, probably not.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy straw hat quiet, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the line where this timeline starts to leak. Luffy is wearing a uniform, but he is not a Marine, and he knows it.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine uniform doubt, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Next stop is Loguetown, the town where Roger was born and where Roger died.

shot.fallback: anime style loguetown execution platform, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And in Loguetown, there's a Marine captain who actually believes in justice. His name is Smoker.

shot.fallback: anime style smoker loguetown marine, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Smoker chases Luffy for chapters, and Luffy only escapes because Dragon shows up out of nowhere.

shot.fallback: anime style smoker luffy loguetown dragon, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here, Smoker is Luffy's superior officer. And Smoker takes one look at Luffy and knows he is trouble.

shot.fallback: anime style smoker luffy marine superior, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: There is also Tashigi, who in canon wants Zoro's sword and goes on to become the Marines' sharpest eye.

shot.fallback: anime style tashigi smoker marine, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Tashigi and Luffy, together, would be a disaster waiting to happen. And Smoker would be the one to fill out the paperwork.

shot.fallback: anime style tashigi luffy smoker, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But then, the execution platform. Luffy stands under it and looks up, the place where Gold Roger smiled and died.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy loguetown execution platform, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, lightning saves Luffy from Buggy's execution here. In this story, Luffy walks right up to the platform and nobody stops him.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy buggy loguetown platform, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And he laughs, just like Roger did. Smoker watches the whole thing.

shot.fallback: anime style roger laugh loguetown smoker, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That is the moment Smoker decides. Luffy is not going to be a Marine, and the Marines should find that out sooner than later.

shot.fallback: anime style smoker watching luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So Garp finds out the way Garp always finds out. By punching the wall.

shot.fallback: anime style garp angry fist, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter three is about the choice.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy garp choice, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Garp says, you are my grandson, and you will be a Marine.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy grandson marine, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy says, I'm going to be the Pirate King. They talk for three days, according to this timeline.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy garp argument, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: What breaks it is Ace. Ace sends a letter, saying he is leaving the mountain, and he is going to sea.

shot.fallback: anime style ace letter leaving mount colubo, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy reads it and he is out the door before Garp can say a word.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy runs marine base, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So Luffy does not become a Marine. He becomes a Marine deserter, and Garp has to chase him.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy deserter marine, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And the chase is where the one thing we really want to see finally happens. Garp, finally, has to use his Haki on Luffy.

shot.fallback: anime style garp haki luffy chase, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Garp is the Hero of the Marines, the man who fought Roger. Luffy is not a match for him yet.

shot.fallback: anime style garp roger fight god valley, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But Luffy is the kid who beat Alvida, and who bounced Smoker's smoke. And the kid just refuses to stay down.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy refuses garp fight, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Garp wins, of course. He drags Luffy to a cell and he doesn't say another word.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy prison cell, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And now, the ripple that matters. Luffy is a prisoner in Marine custody, two years before he should have been anywhere near Impel Down.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine cell impel down, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So who comes for him? Not Ace. Not Shanks. Not a crew he hasn't even met yet.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine cell visitor, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: It's Dragon. The Revolutionary leader, the man who left the Marines because he couldn't stand its justice.

shot.fallback: anime style dragon revolutionary army leader, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Dragon is Garp's own son. That's the first time Luffy ever says the word father out loud.

shot.fallback: anime style dragon garp luffy father, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Dragon breaks him out, and Garp lets it happen. That's the part nobody expects.

shot.fallback: anime style dragon frees luffy cell, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Because Garp, deep down, never wanted a Marine. He wanted a grandson who survived.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy survive, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And in the chaos, Luffy gets his Straw Hat back from the locker and sails out of Marine waters.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy straw hat sail, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter four, Marineford.

shot.fallback: anime style marineford war ace, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: The summit war is still the moment where Luffy's entire story bends. Ace is captured and Whitebeard declares war.

shot.fallback: anime style marineford whitebeard ace execution, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Luffy breaks into Impel Down, fights through Magellan, and crashes the war as a rookie pirate.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy impel down marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here, Luffy has a Marine record. He grew up in their ranks and he knows their ships. That's the new advantage.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine ship marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He gets into Marineford without an Impel Down escape, because he knows the signal codes the Marines would use.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marineford gates, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the one thing a Marine upbringing buys him. Knowledge. Not power, not Haki, just knowledge.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine codes, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And the first Marine he runs into is Koby, who is crying and holding a sword he doesn't know how to use.

shot.fallback: anime style koby marineford crying, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Koby sees Luffy and can't say a word. Luffy tells him to get out of the way, his kindest line in the war.

shot.fallback: anime style koby luffy marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And then Garp, on the platform next to Ace, looking at both of his grandsons at once.

shot.fallback: anime style garp ace luffy marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Garp stands still when Luffy reaches Ace. He doesn't stop him. That's Garp choosing family over the order.

shot.fallback: anime style garp stands still ace execution, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Here's what I think changes. Garp has already let Luffy go once. So in this version, he doesn't hesitate.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Garp steps aside, and he opens the path himself. And the whole Marine line sees their Hero do it.

shot.fallback: anime style garp opens path luffy ace, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: This is where the story gets heavy. Sengoku sees it and gives the order, Garp is arrested on the spot.

shot.fallback: anime style sengoku orders garp arrest, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Akainu watches all of it. Akainu has been waiting for a reason, and now he has one.

shot.fallback: anime style akainu watching garp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Akainu kills Ace because Ace insults Whitebeard. Chapter 574, and it is the cruelest moment in the war.

shot.fallback: anime style akainu ace chapter 574, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In our story, Ace is still the target, and Akainu still strikes. The difference is that this time, Luffy is in position.

shot.fallback: anime style akainu magu magu ace luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Luffy has not been pushed to his limit by two weeks in Impel Down. He is fresh.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy fresh marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So Luffy takes the hit. Akainu's fist burns through the Straw Hat and through Luffy's side, and Ace is thrown clear.

shot.fallback: anime style akainu fist luffy straw hat, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That is the trade, and I think Oda was always afraid to write it. Luffy bleeds, and Ace lives.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy burned akainu ace lives, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But Whitebeard is still on the field. And Whitebeard still dies.

shot.fallback: anime style whitebeard final stand marineford, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, chapter 576, he dies standing and says the One Piece is real. That doesn't change. It's his story.

shot.fallback: anime style whitebeard death chapter 576, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So what do we lose? Not Ace, and not his fruit. We lose Luffy's two years of grief.

shot.fallback: anime style whitebeard pirates ace luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And that's a big loss, because in canon, that grief sends Luffy to Rayleigh, and Rayleigh teaches him Haki.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy rayleigh haki training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Chapter five is the aftermath.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy ace recovering, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy is alive, but he is hurt, and he's in Ace's care. A role reversal, and a funny one.

shot.fallback: anime style ace carrying luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Ace takes the bandages and the blame. He says he should have been the one in Akainu's way.

shot.fallback: anime style ace bandages luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And Luffy says something Shanks would be proud of. He says, the sea doesn't need a hero, it needs a crew.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy straw hat crew shanks, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the moment he starts forming the Straw Hats for real, and that's where the Marines' loss matters.

shot.fallback: anime style straw hat pirates crew formed, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Because the man Garp once wanted to train for justice is now training the people who will fight the World Government.

shot.fallback: anime style garp straw hat justice, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And without the two years, Luffy never learns Haki the way he did, so he is weaker, and he knows it.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy weak haki training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That gives the Marines their best chance. A weaker Luffy, a Marine record behind him, and a Garp in prison.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marines chance, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But a weaker Luffy also needs help, and that help arrives in a way Oda would love.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy needs help crew, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Koby. The same Koby who, in canon, becomes the Hero of the Marines and trains under Garp.

shot.search: Koby Hero of the Marines Garp
shot.fallback: anime style koby hero of the marines garp, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Koby leaves the Marines and joins Luffy. And that's the twist you didn't see coming.

shot.fallback: anime style koby joins luffy crew, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Not because he stopped believing in justice, but because he finally saw where it was.

shot.fallback: anime style koby justice luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So the Straw Hats get their navigator, their cook, their swordsman, and a Marine who knows the signal codes.

shot.fallback: anime style straw hat pirates koby, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And the World Government gets a new problem. A pirate crew with a former Marine in it, led by a kid they raised.

shot.fallback: anime style world government marines straw hats, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now here is the verdict. A Marine Luffy does not break the Marines. He bends them, from the inside, the way Garp always feared.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy garp marines verdict, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But he doesn't win by becoming a Marine. He wins by staying the one thing a Marine can't be, which is free.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy free straw hat, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And honestly, that's the question I'd like Oda to answer before Elbaph ends. What does Garp's justice look like now?

shot.fallback: anime style garp justice elbaph, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And that's the real answer to our opening question. Luffy would not become the hero Garp wanted. He becomes the one he feared.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy hero garp feared, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So tell me in the comments. Is Luffy a better pirate for having been a Marine, or does the uniform ruin the dream?

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine pirate, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And if you want to see what happens when Roger meets young Luffy, that's the next story.

shot.fallback: anime style roger luffy meets, dramatic lighting, no text

published.comment: Is Luffy a better pirate for having been a Marine, or does the uniform ruin the dream? Pick one.
